subject: How to change the branch lengths of a cladogram

messages.author: 31f2c92e16935e19
messages.subject: How to change the branch lengths of a cladogram
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to plot a cladogram built from a text file of taxonomic classifications. Using ape to plot the tree seems to work ok, but using ggtree the branch lengths end up very long - is there any way to adjust this? I would eventually like to be able to use the cladogram alongside a heatmap, which is why I would like to make the tree more compact - at the moment it takes up too much space next to the heatmap (see attached image). Also attached is the reproducible code and files.

I would be very grateful for your help with this.

Many thanks.

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: How to change the branch lengths of a cladogram
parts: I think you only need to adjust the relative width of the tree and the heatmap.

messages.subject: Re: How to change the branch lengths of a cladogram

Is there a way of adjusting the width of the tree separately, while keeping the cells of the heatmap small? I'm sorry if I'm missing something obvious.

Thanks.

I think you only need to adjust the relative width of the tree and the heatmap.
